outcome: loss of function of lower extremities
return of function of lower extremities
cohort: A 32-year-old patient who gave birth by Caesarean section in due term.
finding: Early diagnosis and timely treatment of Longitudinal Extensive Transversal Myelitis (LETM) are crucial for disease prognosis and patient recovery.
mod_finding: The patient developed LETM the same day she gave birth by Caesarean section after receiving epidural anesthesia.
